free_tier.stated: Free has a $0 base price, $50 of credits to start, 10 GB of included volumes and 5 active VMs, with a card kept on file and no charge to start; compute bills $0.000014 per vCPU-second and $0.0000045 per GB-RAM-second, and extra allocated volume storage $0.0002 per GB-hour

per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

egress.terms: Free plan includes egress to known package managers and common AI APIs; Pro adds unrestricted egress or granular domain/CIDR allowlists. No egress allowance or overage price is published on the pricing page.

interface_detail: RESTful API, the instavm Python SDK, the instavm CLI and ssh instavm.dev
tooling: the instavm Python SDK (from instavm import InstaVM), the instavm CLI, and ssh instavm.dev

limits.value: 5 simultaneously active VMs on Free, 100 on Pro
10 GB of included volume storage on Free; volume billing uses allocated size, not bytes written

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented.
